fixed: The Earth from far sat half off the frame with its air too thin to see; it is framed whole now, the air drawn thicker, the beam skimming it to a low Sun.
The cut-open sky did not say which end was which; it is labelled THIN AIR at the top and THICK AIR at the bottom.
Drawn in the same richer look as part 1 where the beach is seen (polish 3).
notes: One journey: from the beach down to the glass and its snapped straw, up to the sky cut open into layers with a beam bending through them, a high Sun whose light drops straight down, and out to the curve of the Earth with a low Sun.
